description: For a business owner who was brought to ShearQuery by an agency: whether that agency can see their account health (read-only: connections, stuck drafts, failures, plan, audit score — never their customers' details), and switching it on or off with share: true/false. Only switch it on when the owner asks to.

share.description: true to let the agency see, false to stop. Leave out to just check.

name: my_agency_access
title: Whether my agency can see my account
